name: Liz Grover
source:
The Exterior Engineer

She serves as the exterior engineer on the space exploration vessel “Settler.”
She has known First Officer John since childhood and is like a younger sister to him. 
She also served in the military as a subordinate during the Resource War. 

Perhaps because of this, even when speaking to him—her superior and someone older than her—she has a cheerful and spirited personality that isn’t afraid to speak her mind.
